input.summary: Start a useful Union Jack mode, spell T-O-M-M-Y at the mirror, then start the four-ball version at the Tommy hole and work from ramp Jackpots to the Tommy-hole ladder and right-ramp Double Super.

quickInfo.name: T-O-M-M-Y
quickInfo.summary: Mirror hits spell TOMMY and lower the mirror to light regular multiball.

quickInfo.name: Best start
quickInfo.summary: The Tommy hole starts four balls and larger base awards; the left scoop starts a smaller three-ball version.

quickInfo.name: Opening jackpots
quickInfo.summary: Left ramp scores Jackpot and upper-flipper right ramp scores Double Jackpot; collect both to advance.

quickInfo.name: Tommy-hole stage
quickInfo.summary: Collect five TOMMY mini-jackpots at the exposed hole to light the Supers.

quickInfo.name: Union Jack modes
quickInfo.summary: Modes continue during regular multiball, so begin one before the multiball start.

steps.text: Test the mirror, Tommy hole, both ramps, and right-scoop eject before choosing the opening mode.
Start a useful Union Jack feature at the right scoop, then continue spelling T-O-M-M-Y at the mirror.
When the mirror lowers, shoot the Tommy hole for the four-ball multiball whenever that feed is controllable.
Collect the left-ramp Jackpot and upper-flipper right-ramp Double Jackpot to advance the first stage.
Take one relit ramp Jackpot in the next stage, then shoot the Tommy hole five times to spell T-O-M-M-Y through mini-jackpots.
At the Super stage, choose the right-ramp Double Super when the upper-flipper feed is controlled; take the easier left-ramp Super when certainty matters.
If no opening Jackpot is collected, use the relit Tommy hole or left-scoop two-ball restart and rebuild ball count through a Jackpot.

fallback.title: Left-scoop start
fallback.when: Use this when multiball is lit but the exposed Tommy-hole shot is rejecting.

steps.text: Shoot the left scoop for the three-ball start.
Collect an immediate ramp Jackpot to add a ball.
Continue the normal jackpot stages with the restored ball count.

alternatives.title: Sally Simpson ramp mode
alternatives.when: Use this when both ramps are repeatable before multiball.

steps.text: Start Sally Simpson at the right scoop.
Use left ramps to raise the following value and right ramps to double it.
Start prepared multiball while the ramp scoring remains active.
Complete both opening ramp Jackpots.
Finish the later ramp and Tommy-hole stages.
Collect a Super or Double Super.
Repeat the jackpot ladder with the blinders active.

techniques.name: Union-Jack-before-multiball order
techniques.instruction: Start a useful Union Jack feature first because its timer and scoring continue during regular multiball.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper Double setup
techniques.instruction: Use the left-ramp or Tommy-hole return to prepare the upper-left flipper before committing to the right-ramp Double award.

cautions.issue: The upper-flipper right ramp is the higher-value but harder Super shot.
cautions.response: Take the left-ramp Super when ball count, feed, or match position does not justify the miss risk.

cautions.issue: The captive ball and hard right-scoop shots can reject toward the outlane or center.
cautions.response: Avoid captive-ball bonus work and back off overpowered scoop shots when their returns are unsafe.

Test both scoops, both ramps, and blinders.
input.simpleOverview: In The Who's Tommy Pinball Wizard, an active Union Jack mode continues during Multiball, but a new mode cannot start or relight after Multiball begins. Start a mode first, spell T-O-M-M-Y at the mirror, then start Multiball at the Tommy hole and advance through the ramp, mini-Jackpot, and Super stages.
input.overview: The Who's Tommy Pinball Wizard lets Union Jack modes continue during Multiball, whose scoring advances through ramp, Tommy-hole, and Super stages. Start a compatible mode, spell T-O-M-M-Y, and use the Tommy-hole four-ball start. Complete both opening ramps, five hole mini-jackpots, then choose the controlled Super or Double Super feed.
